FIELDS.NAME: FreshMart Supermarket
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: FreshMart Supermarket operates as a full-service grocery store, offering a wide variety of fresh produce, dairy products, meats, frozen foods, and packaged goods. With a spacious layout of 3,500 square feet, we prioritize effective risk management and adhere to all local and federal food safety regulations. Our operations include stringent sanitation procedures, proper refrigeration controls for perishable items, and regular pest control measures to ensure a safe shopping environment for our customers. Additionally, we maintain a clean and well-organized store layout to minimize hazards and enhance customer experience. The store is staffed by trained employees who uphold our commitment to quality service and safety protocols, including emergency response plans and compliance with health and safety inspections.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: FreshMart Specialty Foods, LLC - A local bakery and deli offering fresh baked goods and prepared meals.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 05/10/2023; Cause: Water damage from a malfunctioning refrigeration unit; Amount: $7,500; Status: Paid. Loss Date: 02/15/2023; Cause: Shoplifting incident; Amount: $3,000; Status: Pending investigation. Loss Date: 01/12/2023; Cause: Slip and fall accident; Amount: $4,500; Status: Claim filed with insurance.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade safe, UL Class 350, rated for fire protection, dual-lock mechanism.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Full perimeter fencing with security cameras and on-site security personnel during operational hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – FreshMart Supermarket does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. The operations are compliant with all local and federal regulations regarding safety and environmental standards.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – FreshMart Supermarket does not sponsor athletic teams. Our focus remains on providing quality grocery services and community engagement through other initiatives.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The company verifies these certificates to ensure appropriate coverage is in place.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – FreshMart Supermarket has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of crime related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – FreshMart Supermarket has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance matters have been handled smoothly with no interruptions in coverage.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – FreshMart Supermarket does not lease employees to or from other employers. We maintain our own staff to ensure consistency in service and adherence to our operational standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – FreshMart Supermarket carries workers' compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and protect employees in case of work-related injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – FreshMart Supermarket also owns and operates FreshMart Specialty Foods, LLC, which is a local bakery and deli specializing in fresh baked goods and prepared meals.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – FreshMart Supermarket currently does not have any other insurance with this company. The only active policy is FM-SG-2023-0001.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – FreshMart Supermarket is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. We primarily operate as a full-service grocery store offering a variety of retail goods.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – FreshMart Supermarket does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations focus solely on providing grocery services to our customers.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – FreshMart Supermarket has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The financial standing of the business remains stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – FreshMart Supermarket does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as we operate a grocery store focused on food and retail products, maintaining strict compliance with safety standards.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – FreshMart Supermarket does not have any catastrophe exposure, as we maintain strict compliance with industry regulations and have effective risk management protocols in place to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – FreshMart Supermarket has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company adheres to stringent hiring practices and policies to ensure a safe and compliant workplace.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – FreshMart Supermarket does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. The store maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations and has undergone recent inspections confirming this.
